ORDER BY icam12_icam_company_cd, icam12_fund_cd LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}

SELECT icam13_std_date AS std_date, icam13_result AS result, icam13_diff_amt AS diff_amt, f_emp_kor_nm(icam13_worker) AS worker_name, to_char(icam13_work_date,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') AS work_date_string FROM icam13_fee_book_check WHERE icam13_company_id = #{companyId} AND icam13_std_date = #{stdDate} ORDER BY icam13_fee_book_check_id

WITH ast33 AS ( SELECT ast33_fund_trans.* , sys15_corp_cd as ast33_corp_cd FROM ast33_fund_trans INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast33_corp_id INNER JOIN icam10_fee ON ( icam10_company_id = ast33_company_id AND icam10_icam_company_cd = sys15_corp_cd AND icam10_fund_cd = ast33_fund_cd AND icam10_rmk_cd = 'P00' AND icam10_std_date = #{closeDate} ) WHERE ast33_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast33_fund_trans_cd = '2' /*(2:이관(입))*/ AND ast33_date > icam10_bf_pay_date ) , biz17 AS ( SELECT biz17_dual_manage_fund.* , sys15_corp_cd as biz17_corp_cd FROM biz17_dual_manage_fund INNER JOIN biz13_with_corp ON biz13_cont_corp_id = biz17_cont_corp_id INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = biz13_corp_id WHERE biz17_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz17_start_date BETWEEN date_trunc('month',#{closeDate}::date)::date AND #{closeDate}::date AND biz13_manage_type = '1' /*(1:자산운용)*/ ) , icam AS ( SELECT icam12_icam_company_cd , icam12_fund_cd , icam12_fund_nm , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ast33 WHERE ast33_corp_cd = icam12_icam_company_cd AND ast33_fund_cd = icam12_fund_cd UNION ALL SELECT 2 FROM biz17 WHERE biz17_corp_cd = icam12_icam_company_cd AND biz17_fund_cd = icam12_fund_cd ) THEN ( SELECT SUM(f_calc_dual_fund_fee( icam10_company_id , icam10_icam_company_cd , icam10_fund_cd , icam10_std_date , icam10_fee ) * CASE WHEN icam10_drcr_type = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) FROM icam10_fee WHERE icam10_company_id = icam12_company_id AND icam10_icam_company_cd = icam12_icam_company_cd AND icam10_fund_cd = icam12_fund_cd AND icam10_rmk_cd IN ('P00','D20','D30') /* (P00:보수 및 수수료(비용)발생 / D20:보수인출 / D30:해지금/보수인출) */ AND icam10_std_date BETWEEN date_trunc('month',#{closeDate}::date)::date AND #{closeDate}::date ) + COALESCE(ast30_for_fee,0) ELSE f_calc_dual_fund_fee( icam12_company_id , icam12_icam_company_cd , icam12_fund_cd , icam12_std_date , icam12_for_fee ) END as icam12_for_fee , f_calc_dual_fund_fee( icam12_company_id , icam12_icam_company_cd , icam12_fund_cd , icam12_std_date , icam12_for_fee ) as icam12_for_fee2 FROM icam12_fee_book LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sys15_corp_cd , ast30_fund_cd , ast30_for_fee FROM ast30_book_fund_fee INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast30_corp_id WHERE ast30_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast30_hold_date = (date_trunc('month', #{closeDate}::date) + interval '-1day')::date ) t ON ( sys15_corp_cd = icam12_icam_company_cd AND ast30_fund_cd = icam12_fund_cd ) WHERE icam12_company_id = #{companyId} AND icam12_std_date = #{closeDate} ) , erp AS ( SELECT * FROM ast30_book_fund_fee INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast30_corp_id WHERE ast30_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast30_hold_date = #{closeDate} ) SELECT company_cd AS corp_code , sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name , fund_cd AS fund_code , fund_nm AS fund_name , icam_fee AS icam_fee , ast_fee AS for_fee , CASE WHEN icam_fee != ast_fee THEN icam_fee ELSE icam_fee2 END - ast_fee AS diff_fee FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT * FROM ( /*================== ICAM = AssetERP(+) ====================== */ SELECT icam12_icam_company_cd as company_cd , icam12_fund_cd as fund_cd , icam12_fund_nm as fund_nm , icam12_for_fee as icam_fee , icam12_for_fee2 as icam_fee2 , COALESCE(ast30_for_fee, 0) as ast_fee , CASE WHEN ast30_fund_cd IS NULL THEN ' (AssetERP 정보 미존재)' ELSE '' END as note FROM icam LEFT JOIN erp ON ( sys15_corp_cd = icam12_icam_company_cd AND ast30_fund_cd = icam12_fund_cd ) WHERE icam12_for_fee != COALESCE(ast30_for_fee, 0) AND icam12_for_fee2 != COALESCE(ast30_for_fee, 0) /*==================== AssetERP = ICAM(+) ======================*/ UNION ALL SELECT sys15_corp_cd as company_cd , ast30_fund_cd as fund_cd , ast30_fund_nm as fund_nm , COALESCE(icam12_for_fee , 0) as icam_fee , COALESCE(icam12_for_fee2, 0) as icam_fee2 , ast30_for_fee as ast_fee , CASE WHEN icam12_fund_cd IS NULL THEN ' (ICAM 정보 미존재)' ELSE '' END as note FROM erp LEFT JOIN icam ON ( icam12_icam_company_cd = sys15_corp_cd AND icam12_fund_cd = ast30_fund_cd ) WHERE ast30_for_fee != COALESCE(icam12_for_fee , 0) AND ast30_for_fee != COALESCE(icam12_for_fee2, 0) ) t ) tt LEFT JOIN sys15_corp ON ( sys15_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys15_corp_cd = company_cd AND sys15_use_yn = 'true' ) ORDER BY company_cd, fund_cd
